roles.use_summary: Used ASCAT3.2.0 to infer allele-specific copy-number segments from targeted sequencing, using capture-region SNPs selected with normal samples and sequencing-derived logR/BAF. The WGS workflow separately uses ascatNgs.
roles.remaining_scope: The scoped original3.2.0 targeted panel/count/preparation/fitting APIs are available after qualification. Exact author reference sets, correction choices, bounds/penalty, homozygosity exclusion and the separate ascatNgs WGS pipeline are not inferred or reproduced.

legacy_main_text_roles_preserved.role: Targeted-sequencing allele-specific copy-number segments from capture-region SNPs identified with normal samples, allele counts, logR and BAF.
legacy_main_text_roles_preserved.qualification: Requires capture BED, normal-panel SNP selection, allele counting, sequencing preparation, correction, segmentation and complete model/QC. A highly homozygous case was excluded by the authors; the numerical component does not reproduce this decision.

roles.use_summary: Used ASCAT2.5.2 as a somatic copy-number comparator on short-read data and500 simulated genomes; evaluated breakpoint accuracy and total/allelic copy-number RMSE in10-kb bins. The separate400-genome AHR comparison and JaBbA graph workflow are not attributed to ASCAT.
roles.remaining_scope: Original2.5.2 matrix fitting is available under a separately qualified R4.0.2 runtime. Author SNP selection/count inputs, single-versus-joint segmentation, penalty and complete benchmark pipeline remain unspecified or separate. Notes3/6 describe GRCh37/BWA0.7.17, HapMap3.3/Rsamtools matched-normal ALT fraction strictly0.2to0.8,80X/40X simulation, correct-strand breakends within10kb and10-kb RMSE bins excluding >90percent CN-unmappable overlap. These details do not establish an ASCAT command recipe.

legacy_main_text_roles_preserved.role: ASCAT 2.5.2 is a somatic copy-number comparator on short-read GRCh37 tumor/cell-line data and 500 simulated genomes. Benchmarking assesses same-strand breakends within 10 kb and total/allelic copy-number RMSE across 10-kb bins.
legacy_main_text_roles_preserved.qualification: JaBbA performance is not attributed to ASCAT. Supplementary Notes 3 and 6 remain required for the full recipe; retrieval failed. Legacy full segmentation under the installed R 4.6.2 failed and is not admitted.

roles.use_summary: Imported released TCGA purity/ploidy estimates from ASCAT ReleasedData/TCGA_SNP6_hg38. This is reuse of existing estimates, without a reported fresh ASCAT execution or software version.
roles.remaining_scope: Retain the released-estimate import role; fresh fitting with an explicitly selected profile is a different analysis. No historical execution, release provenance or version is inferred from the current comparison runtimes.

legacy_main_text_roles_preserved.role: Imports previously estimated TCGA purity and ploidy from the ASCAT ReleasedData/TCGA_SNP6_hg38 repository directory.
legacy_main_text_roles_preserved.qualification: Released-estimate import is distinct from fresh ASCAT fitting. The main-text context does not report an ASCAT version or establish a fresh execution recipe.

roles.use_summary: Used paired-germline exome copy-number analysis through ASCAT after ConstructASCATFiles coverage/BAF extraction and PREASCAT normalization, with segmentation penalty100 and additional sample/event filters. The core ASCAT version is unreported; WGS separately uses an internal ascatNgs4.5.0 workflow.
roles.remaining_scope: Core R version remains unreported. Matched normal exome fitting uses penalty100. Methods reject no-optimum or goodness<90percent, whereas extended results describe goodness>90percent; equality is not resolved. Filters remove <1Mb segments, chrX, described chr6Mb20to38 MHC and chr14Mb19 artifacts, matched-normal/shared-lesional-nonlesional/near-universal within-individual events, and samples with >10calls AND purity<0.4. Coordinate/overlap/event equivalence conventions are not invented. ConstructASCATFiles/PREASCAT runtime use is SKIP3 pending source-wide permission; internal ascatNgs4.5.0 and full author workflow remain unqualified.
